support-joan: customer-impact: model generation failures and elevated latency.

sre-oncall-maya: starting drain (grace=120s): `kubectl drain gpu-node-mls-43 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

eng-runtime-omar: traffic re-routed to fallback-quantized-cpu for acme-inc and trial prefixes. Confirming no more 503 spikes.
support-joan: CS updated, customer-facing note drafted: "We're investigating degraded model availability for select customers; mitigation in progress."

sre-oncall-maya: handing off to infra-luke for RMA and recovery. my shift ends in 20m — luke taking lead.
infra-luke: taking over. will follow up in 30m with RMA ETA. tagging @eng-sre-team

sre-oncall-maya: closing loop for now — if any regressions ping me or reopen PD incident.
